runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Nasi Goreng, Fuku-Style Nashville Hot Fried Chicken Sandwich, Wild Mushrooms on Toast
runs.content:
1. Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice) — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A 25-minute weeknight fix built on cold rice, kecap manis, and shrimp paste — the Indonesian dish he championed on A Cook's Tour and Parts Unknown.
2. Fuku-Style Nashville Hot Fried Chicken Sandwich — inspired by David Chang. A medium-technique project built on Chang's Fuku fast-casual format — buttermilk brine, double dredge, hot oil finish, gochujang mayo.
3. Wild Mushrooms on Toast with Thyme and Cream — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the first wild mushrooms of early autumn, treated with almost nothing but butter, garlic, and cream.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: One-Pan Turkey Sausage & Kale Skillet, Momofuku Pork Belly Bao Buns, Blackberry and Apple Crumble
runs.content:
1. One-Pan Turkey Sausage, White Bean and Kale Skillet — inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 30-minute one-pan weeknight fix built around kale as the first cooler September mornings arrive.
2. Momofuku-Style Pork Belly Bao Buns — inspired by David Chang. A weekend technique project — the iconic Momofuku dish itself, a slow braise plus steamed bao, hadn't made it into the collection yet.
3. Blackberry and Apple Crumble — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the definitive turn-of-season pudding, built around hedgerow blackberries and the first Bramley apples.
